name: Send Telegram message
description: Sends a text message to a Telegram chat through one of the venue's bots. Use it to notify a person or group from an agent or workflow. chatId is the numeric Telegram chat id (a user's private chat, or a negative group id — the bot's /id command shows it) or an @channelusername the bot administers. Long text is split at Telegram's 4096-character limit; if a parseMode is requested and Telegram rejects the formatting, the message is resent as plain text. Requires telegram/send on <bot owner>/telegram/<bot>: the bot's configured user (and their agents, within scope) may send; others need a delegation from that user.

bot.description: Bot name (adapters.telegram.bots key). Optional when the caller owns exactly one bot.

parseMode.description: Formatting mode. Defaults to the bot's configured parseMode, else plain text.

silent.description: Deliver without a notification sound (default false)

messageId.description: Telegram id of the (last) sent message
